Cost: Mailchimp's plan comparison shows the Free plan with up to 250 contacts (one pricing page line also mentions fewer than 500). The pricing pages do not say whether API access is included on the Free plan, so we could not confirm it. Paid plans are Essentials, Standard and Premium. With the USD view, Essentials starts at $8.87 a month for the smallest contact tier (the page also shows a 50% off promotion for 12 months). Prices rise with contact count.

Good to know: the root endpoint returns a pricing_plan_type field (monthly, pay_as_you_go or forever_free), which you can use to check the account.

Does Mailchimp Marketing API have a free tier?
Free tier: Free plan (250 contacts); API access not confirmed.

Pricing model: Paid. Pricing starts from $8.87/mo. Essentials at the smallest contact tier, USD list price (a 50% promo for 12 months is shown). Rises with contacts.

title: How to access your API key in Mailchimp
snippet:
In the screenshot and bullet points below, you'll find the pricing across the subscriptions for 500 contacts; you can easily change that number on their [pricing page](https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/).
- **Premium**: $350/month, which includes 15,000 monthly email sends, unlimited users, unlimited audiences, and a lot more
- **Standard:** $20/month, which includes 6,000 monthly email sends, 5 user seats, and 5 audiences, and 1 personalized on-boarding session
- **Essentials:** Free for 1 month and then $13/month after. This plan includes 5,000 monthly email sends, 3 user seats, and 3 audiences, with limited reporting and analytics
- **Free:** $0/month, which includes the basics: 1,000 monthly email sends, 1 user seat, 1 audience, and limited reporting and analytics

title: anchorterminal.com/tools/mailchimp-marketing

| Pricing | Freemium ($13 / mo) · The Free plan has 250 contacts and 500 sends a month (250 a day), one audience and one seat, with no time limit. Paid plans start at $13 a month for Essentials, $20 for Standard and $350 for Premium with USD selected, and rise with the contact count. API calls are not metered. The 14-day trial of a paid plan needs payment details. An agent's owner can start on the Free plan without a contract (https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/, https://mailchimp.com/help/about-mailchimp-pricing-plans/).

| Plans | Free 250 contacts and 500 sends a month. Essentials up to 50,000 contacts with sends at 10 times the contact limit. Standard up to 100,000 with 12 times. Premium by quote above 250,000. What the API can do depends on the plan |
